title: Dirty South Yoga Fest
description: Returning for the 11th year Dirty South Yoga Fest will be at Loudermilk on October 17th. Tickets must be purchased on DSYF website.
long_description:
Returning for the 11th year Dirty South Yoga Fest will be at Loudermilk on October 17th. Tickets must be purchased on DSYF website.

About this Event

Join us for a full day of movement, connection and community at Dirty South Yoga Fest 2026.
Atlanta's yoga festival is back with this year's theme, Community in Practice. Purchase Tickets Here! Use code Eventbrite to save on your ticket.
Saturday, October 17 at Loudermilk Conference Center, DSYF brings together dozens of teachers across vinyasa/flow, restorative and Yin, sound bath, and more, alongside a full day of vendors, sponsors, and community connection.
Whether you're a longtime yogi or trying your first class, there's a session built for you. Come move, breathe, and practice alongside your community.
Tickets are available now
